arabic text:
Aa dekh mere gazi, uncha hai alam tera
Dil sine me jab tak hai bhulega na gham tera
Aa dekh mere……….
Zainab ki duwa bankar ik waqt wo aayenga
Har gar me saja honga, abbas alam tera
Dil sine me jab tak hai bhulega na gham tera
Aa dekh mere……….
Ajati hai zehra bhi zainab bhi ziyarat ko
Jab aat muharam ko ut tha hai alam tera
Dil sine me jab tak hai bhulega na gham tera
Aa dekh mere……….
Tabut jab ut tha hai shabbir ka ay gazi
Tabut ke age bhi chalta hai alam tera
Dil sine me jab tak hai bhulega na gham tera
Aa dekh mere……….
Wo kon se sadme the sheh toot gaye jis se
Ik dard tha zainab ka aur doosra gham tera
Dil sine me jab tak hai bhulega na gham tera
Aa dekh mere……….
Parcham ka pharera tha ya aas thi zainab ki
Zainab ke kaleje se ham kaise ho kam tera
Dil sine me jab tak hai bhulega na gham tera
Aa dekh mere……….
Bazar me zinda me darbar me har lamha
Zainab ki to sanso pe he naam rakam tera
Dil sine me jab tak hai bhulega na gham tera
Aa dekh mere……….
Jab beh gaya sab paani tab aas teri tooti
tha sine ke andariya mashkize me dam tera
